question: What if I put 10% in Tesla?

answer.answer: I checked 10% in Tesla against your limits, and it doesn't pass: it fails checks C1, G4 and G9. That portfolio's worst drop would have been -14.3%, about $57,158, which is very close to your 15% loss limit of $60,000. Tesla's own worst drop between 2021 and 2026 was -70.9%. At 10%, that alone would cost about -7.1% of your portfolio, more than the share of your loss limit any one company may use, so the most one company can hold is about 3.1%. Even at that smaller size the portfolio's worst drop would have been -9.6% (about $38,241), and it still fails checks C1 and G4, so it doesn't fully fit your limits either.

why.TSLA: TSLA's worst drop in 2021-2026 was -70.9%; at 10% that alone would be -7.1% of the portfolio, more than the 25% of your 15% loss limit one asset may use; you can hold about 15% in stocks, and one company is kept to 1/5 of that; it fits up to 3.1%
